name: Create SEB Exam Configuration
description: Create a new SEB exam configuration named 'CS101 Final Exam Configuration' in the SEB Server web interface. Navigate to 'Exam Configuration' under 'Configurations' in the left sidebar, then click 'Add Exam Configuration' in the right-side action panel to create a new configuration. Set the name to 'CS101 Final Exam Configuration' and provide a description 'Secure configuration for CS101 Introduction to Computer Science final examination'. After creating the configuration, you need to navigate through the configuration settings tabs to adjust the following: In the Browser settings, disable 'Allow browser window reload'. In the Security settings, enable 'Allow Virtual Machine Detection'. Save all changes. The SEB Server is accessible at http://localhost:8080 with login credentials super-admin / admin.
